# Hull of a Party

> Statement balloon installations, venue styling and full event design in Hull, run by Lily and Ellie.
> Designed and installed across Hull and East Yorkshire.
> Tagline: we throw a Hull of a party.
> Brand line: balloons & decor for any occasion. Brand palette: black, gold & champagne (by Ellie).

## Contact
- Email: hello@hullofaparty.co.uk
- Founders: Lily (the planner) and Ellie (the eye)
- Based in: Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire
- Areas covered: Hull, Beverley, Cottingham, Hessle, Willerby, Anlaby, Kirk Ella, Hedon, Brough and the wider East Riding
- Instagram / TikTok / Facebook: @hullofapartyuk

## What they do
- Balloon installations: organic garlands, arches, columns, number and letter pieces, ceiling installs, balloon walls, personalised bubbles
- Venue styling: backdrops, shimmer walls, tablescapes, centrepieces, light-up numbers, neon, props and finishing touches
- Full event design: theme and palette design, complete venue dressing, install before and strike after
- Occasions: birthdays, weddings, baby showers, engagements, graduations, proms, christenings, corporate, launch nights

## The collections (guide pricing)
- The Edit: from £45 (organic garland, curated palette, delivered and installed)
- The Statement: from £120 (arch or XL garland, backdrop, light-up piece, install and strike)
- The Takeover: from £250 (complete venue styling, designed end to end)
- Every piece quoted properly, free, after a short consultation

## House rules
- Nothing off the shelf: every install designed from a blank page
- Design first: moodboard before balloon
- Leave no trace: install before guests arrive, strike after they leave

- Reviews and social posts shown are examples while the business launches.
